messages.content: Help me signal the end of an XML element with the qualified name `{namespaceURI='http://www.example.com', localPart='item', prefix='ex'}` and augmentation information `augmentations` in an XML processing application that uses namespaces?

function.name: XMLNamespaceBinder_endElement
function.description: Signals the end of an XML element, handling namespace-related processing if namespaces are enabled, or delegating to the document handler otherwise. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

element.description: The qualified name of the element that is ending. Use QName object, has a constructor that takes in three parameters, namespaceURI, localPart, prefix This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

augs.description: Augmentation information associated with the element. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function XMLNamespaceBinder_endElement with element as a QName object constructed from namespaceURI, localPart, prefix. In Java 8 SDK syntax, we pass a string representation of the QName object. So we need to construct a QName object: new QName("http://www.example.com", "item", "ex"). Then augmentations string.

Thus call:

functions.XMLNamespaceBinder_endElement({
  element: "new QName(\"http://www.example.com\", \"item\", \"ex\")",
  augs: "augmentations"
})

But maybe they want the actual string representation of the QName object. According to description: "This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation." So we provide the string representation of the QName object. That could be something like "QName{namespaceURI=http://www.example.com, localPart=item, prefix=ex}". But they said use QName object, has a constructor that takes in three parameters. So likely they expect the string "new QName('http://www.example.com','item','ex')". Let's do that.

Thus output JSON with function call.
